tokens.name: teal-green
tokens.usage: Primary brand teal (light mode): buttons, the route line, the logo. Off-white text on it reads 5.2:1.

tokens.name: light-mint
tokens.usage: Primary light: highlights and soft backgrounds. Charcoal text on it 13:1; teal-green text 4.9:1.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Neutral dark: text in light mode, surfaces in dark mode.

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: Neutral light: the light-mode background and text on teal-green.

tokens.name: warm-sand
tokens.usage: Accent for friendly, parked moments and sponsored cards. Charcoal text only (10.5:1); teal-green text on sand is 3.9:1, so large text only.

tokens.name: bright-teal
tokens.usage: Dark-mode primary: buttons, route and logo on charcoal (5.9:1). Labels on it are charcoal, never white (white is 2.4:1).

tokens.name: light-teal
tokens.usage: Teal text on dark backgrounds (9.9:1 on charcoal).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and app background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and banners that sit above surface. Supporting neutral, not part of the core palette.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised, light-mint and warm-sand.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface (7.2:1 light, 10:1 dark). Supporting neutral, not part of the core palette.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders only, never text. Supporting neutral.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Buttons, the active route line, selected states.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill: off-white in light mode, charcoal in dark mode.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal text and links on surface: "Kitani" in the lockup, highlighted words.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Chips and highlight backgrounds; text on it is always charcoal.

tokens.name: friendly
tokens.usage: Background for parked, warm moments and sponsored cards; text on it is charcoal.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px surface gap.

tokens.name: report-careful
tokens.usage: RESERVED for map warnings: Careful badge. Its icon is charcoal, not white (white is 1.9:1). Never a brand colour.

tokens.name: report-jammed
tokens.usage: RESERVED for map warnings: Jammed badge and the Peak Spot zone. White icon 3.6:1. Never a brand colour.

tokens.name: report-danger
tokens.usage: RESERVED for map warnings: Danger badge. White icon 4.8:1. Never a brand colour.

tokens.name: report-flooded
tokens.usage: RESERVED for map warnings: Flooded badge. White icon 5.2:1. Same lightness as teal-green, so it is told apart by its wave icon, never by hue alone.

tokens.name: report-closed
tokens.usage: RESERVED for map warnings: Closed badge. Needs its white ring to show on dark maps (1.35:1 against charcoal without it).

tokens.name: report-icon
tokens.usage: Icon colour inside report badges (except Careful).

tokens.name: report-ink-careful
tokens.usage: Icon colour inside the yellow Careful badge (7.7:1).

tokens.name: report-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px ring around every report badge so it holds on any map tile.

tokens.name: peak-zone
tokens.usage: RESERVED: translucent orange area for a Peak Spot on the map.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Bertolak sebelum 7:10 untuk sampai tepat masa.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Reports from Bruneian drivers keep this route accurate.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels and badges; may be uppercase.

styles.name: turn-street
styles.usage: Bold turn instruction; wraps to two lines, never truncates mid-word.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on parked screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height for anything tapped while driving.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, turn banner, social cards.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: Approximates the rounded square of the app icon artwork when a container must match it.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Report badges (circles) and pill buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Turn banner and bottom sheet floating over the map. Never on the logo.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Default icon grid.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width for every outline icon.

tokens.name: badge-size
